projects.title: Inteliedu
projects.description:
This project is an AI-powered interactive 3D teaching and learning platform designed to improve the way complex educational concepts are taught and understood.

The system provides separate interfaces for teachers and students. Teachers can create classes, upload learning materials, add interactive 3D models, conduct live classes, create quizzes, and monitor student performance. Students can join classes, interact with 3D educational models, access notes, participate in quizzes, and communicate with an AI teaching assistant.
